profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Application Development | Embedded Platforms
profile.summary:
With more than a decade of designing and developing software in complex technical environments, I am a results-driven Senior Software Developer that has become an asset to my clients, which include Commercial, Government and Military customers. I am a proactive leader that propels high-level development initiatives into the delivery of dynamic solutions, leveraging expertise in real-time embedded systems and application development.

My areas of specialization include:
•	Software Development & Engineering
•	Cross-Functional Leadership
•	Application Development
•	Embedded Platforms
•	Communication Buses & Protocols
•	Project Management
•	C/C++
•	Linux/Unix
•	UML

positions.title: Senior Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
Lead projects supporting MQ-9A/B Predator B UAV for DHS-CBP customer and internal R&D through full software development lifecycle (SDLC). Serve as primary point of contact for application components across engineering groups. Provide technical guidance for developers. Drive system software architecture and component design. Review work products. Perform aircraft software development.
• Lead project to integrate Big Wing capability on DHS-CBP aircraft. Define system software design that leverages software components from other systems and manages technical debt. Develop software to automatically configure aircraft flight control surfaces and associated components to reduce operator workload.  
• Led effort to integrate airborne civil communication radio on DHS-CBP aircraft. Closely collaborated with product vendor to develop radio control protocol. Developed software to interface with radio and ground control station. Drove project to successful outcome despite many obstacles, including contract delays, staffing issues, and technical design challenges to satisfy system requirements.   
• Led aircraft system software development for the MQ-9B SkyGuardian UAV flight demonstration in partnership with NASA. Developed software to support Sense and Avoid capability and prototype C-Band data link. Assimilated and trained the technical project team on aircraft platform and associated code base. Assisted with ground station software development. Project nominated for Operational Excellence Award.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Performed aircraft software development for projects supporting MQ-9A Predator B and MQ-1 Predator A UAVs for DHS-CBP and Army customers and internal R&D. Designed, developed, and maintained embedded applications in C/C++ for Flight Computer (PowerPC, Bare-metal), Payload Control Computer (PowerPC, Linux), and Sense and Avoid processor (Intel Atom, Linux). Served as subject matter expert for aircraft subsystems integration and lab development environment.   
• Oversaw aircraft software development, catalyzing the effort to demonstrate GPS Anti-Jam capability on aircraft. Developed object-oriented control interface and algorithm to combine and correlate direction finding status from four GPS Anti-Jam control units.
• Drove the effort to integrate support for Inmarsat Satcom data link on aircraft. Developed software to interface with Inmarsat airborne data terminal. Resolved issue with aircraft telemetry with data terminal vendor and supported initial test flights.
• Identified issue that caused significant delays in processing of track data from airborne collision avoidance system. Characterized TCP traffic using Wireshark. Assisted with development of solution which virtually eliminated TCP retransmissions and reduced average CPU utilization of application by greater than 60%.
• Resolved a critical flight computer synchronization issue that allowed the DHS-CBP government customer to extend use of legacy aircraft and avoid costly hardware modifications.
• Recognized for outstanding contributions to Guardian MQ-9A Predator B UAV project. Re-designed existing software modules to support additional airborne radios and video encoders. Developed fault monitoring capability for maritime radar subsystem under tight timeline.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Led development of air vehicle simulation software, working in support of Hunter, a joint tactical unmanned aerial vehicle in service with the Army. Designed and implemented simulator code changes required to model new capabilities on updated Hunter air vehicles and ground control stations.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Resolved software trouble reports for the Enhanced Naval Warfare Gaming System (ENWGS), a theater-level interactive simulation of the warfare environment in support of Navy training.
• Designed, developed, and maintained complex Unix/Linux based client-server applications.
• Spearheaded software/hardware porting task as part of ENWGS modernization effort. Involved in all technical aspects of transition effort from conception to deployment.
• Cited for outstanding contributions to ENWGS modernization effort.

projects.title: Animated Light Display
projects.description:
Designed, configured, and deployed animated holiday light display with 693 RGB LED Pixel Lights controlled from open-source light sequencing application running in Embedded Linux on ARM Cortex based Single Board Computer (SBC). 
• Integrated ESP8266 based development board to control power for static LED light fixtures using GPIO outputs and Solid-state relay. Utilized open-source application that provides web server for device configuration/status and E1.31 interface to control GPIO outputs. Ported and re-designed application using FreeRTOS based SDK to separate and prioritize program functions. Added WebSocket interface for real-time application monitoring.
• Designed and built custom enclosure for outdoor lighting control components.
